verdict.comment: Preference is for DAWN OF LIBERATION, who won by 4l at Nottingham recently and is 3lb well-in under a 5lb penalty.

comments.alazwar: On a reduced mark and was second on his reappearance; goes on the shortlist
comments.dawnofliberation: Rejuvenated 6yo who has won his last two; had 4l to spare last week and is well treated
comments.ellexis: Won off 1lb higher on AW in January but her subsequent form hasn't come up to scratch
comments.enthused: His last Flat win came back in 2022 but he went close at Brighton recently; respected
comments.fasterbee: May have needed his stable debut but regressive and needs to prove his stamina
comments.liberatedlad: Versatile sort who has posted fair efforts the last twice and might not be far away
comments.meadram: Won at Chelmsford (AW) in March but the suitability of turf is questionable nowadays

races.raceComment: alazwar is marginally preferred with a score of 48.1%, holding clear edges in more progressive over warningsign. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts. verdict.comment: Snow Berry and Mrs Trump should go well but PAPA DON'T PREACH (nap) can resume winning ways back at 5f.

comments.bernardspierpoint: Multiple winner but not at his best on AW in March; changed trainer again since
comments.doralee: Lightly-raced 4yo; not beaten far on her return 6 weeks ago; needs more but it's possible
comments.freepic: Big prices & well beaten in three 7f runs; down in trip for h'cap debut; could fare better
comments.kybercrystal: 5f win at Musselburgh in April; two solid runs since; needs to raise her game to take this
comments.mrstrump: 2nd in both course runs, including this race last year; good 2nd at Beverley latest; solid
comments.papadontpreach: Comes here in good form and the return to 5f won't hurt; solid contender
comments.refuge: Good 2nd at Hamilton but unable to replicate that form at Pontefract on Monday
comments.snowberry: Goes well here and she was a close 2nd over C&D last month; high on the list
comments.soldiersdesign: Continues to slide down the weights but the new cheekpieces need to give her a major lift

races.raceComment: snowberry is marginally preferred with a score of 54.4%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form over kybercrystal. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 5 wins from 16 starts in similar conditions, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Longer distance reduces impact of draw position

verdict.comment: This looks a golden opportunity for SEA FORCE to get off the mark. Newcastle third Cameron Highlander is the obvious danger.

comments.antipodes: In good hands but more one for the longer term judged on debut effort
comments.cameronhighlander: Promising third on AW debut in March and back from three months off with yard in from
comments.givemethenight: Fair form when fourth on 7f Kempton debut 15 days ago; may do better
comments.moyowasi: Just over 16l behind Sea Force when they clashed at Doncaster earlier in the season
comments.seaforce: Sets a high standard on his near misses over 7f this spring; likely to stay 1m
comments.timelyaffair: 12-1, beaten 15l when sixth on 1m Goodwood debut; needs significant improvement
comments.zaramara: Modest form in her two starts; outsider

races.raceComment: seaforce is marginally preferred with a score of 21.9%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions over cameronhighlander. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good ground from 2 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, potentially favoring the selection's run style. Yet to win at nottingham in 3 attempts. Key attributes include superior ratings and positive comments, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: A Major Payne should go well but slight preference is for MYSTERYOFTHESANDS, who ran well in a big field at York last time.

comments.amajorpayne: Went close on AW latest and should be competitive back on turf off only 1lb higher
comments.ageoftime: Struggled in two outings on AW over winter and watching brief advised for new yard
comments.barleybrown: Never involved at Redcar 16 days ago, taking his turf record to 1-13
comments.encourageable: Third on yard debut but poor at Leicester since; headgear reached for now
comments.mysteryofthesands: Won at Beverley (7.5f) last month and fair run in big field at York since; player
comments.narmar: Cheekpieces go on and worth a betting check from reduced mark back on turf
comments.rockstaricon: Mixed results in handicaps last year but mark has come down and his yard is in form
comments.tempertrap: Last five wins on soft or heavy so best watched unless the ground eases considerably
comments.waitingforlove: AW novice win on second of three runs last year; makes turf and handicap debut; unexposed

races.raceComment: tempertrap is marginally preferred with a score of 51.0%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form over barleybrown.
